summary: Stable and development release channels: a dev branch beside main; the Release workflow (both forge copies) publishes main as stable and dev as a development pre-release (vX.Y.Z-dev.N, Debian X.Y.Z~dev.N) into its own download tree (/downloads/dev) and Gitea pre-release with the newest three kept, and never deploys the website; release-version.py numbers development builds, release-publish.py orders them numerically, gitea-release.py gains retention; phase1, image and github checks also run on dev pushes; a development build defaults to the dev channel; an Update channel picker appears on each host's card in Controller Settings, Updates and on the host-local Updates page, using the existing host-local PUT /api/local/v1/updates/settings.

guide.reason: Operators now choose a channel and maintainers publish to two channels; both pages describe the selectors, the development archive and downloads, the version numbering, the retention and the troubleshooting. They state that the selectors were not walked through.

api.reason: No contract change: the channel is selected through the existing host-local PUT /api/local/v1/updates/settings (channel and base_url together) and reported in Inventory.image.channel; the Controller UI picker uses the existing settings relay. No new route, Controller route or managed command.

roadmap.reason: Release and update plumbing for development builds; no roadmap milestone changed status.

state.reason: A host's channel is Core state on that host and the Controller keeps nothing: the picker only asks the host to change it and shows what the host reports. The release side keeps its state on the publishing host (the download tree) and in Gitea releases, not in the Controller.
state.record: Host-local /etc/nex/updates.conf: channel= (reported in Inventory.image.channel). A fresh Controller reads the channel from each host's next report with the same value.

verification.method: python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -p 'test_*.py' (test_host_tool_isolation needs the refusing virsh stub in every package that reaches vmhost, including internal/controller); go test of ./internal/nexupdate ./internal/localcore ./internal/controller ./internal/protocol; web channel and image-updates tests and tsc --noEmit; scripts/generate_api.py --check and tests/test_api_contract.py. The release workflow steps ran for real under bash against recording stand-ins for ssh, scp and python3, and the reachability step against a local HTTP server. Not run: a forge release, the website host, a browser walkthrough, the website build and any image build.
